**0.6.2: app updates, from the app and from apt.**

- **Hebrish tells you when there's a new version**, at start and about once a day, with a strip at the top of the window and one tray notification. *Not now* hides it until the next version. Turn it off, or check by hand, under Settings → App updates.
- **Ubuntu: updates through apt.** The .deb now adds the signed Hebrish APT repository (`https://cdn.hebrish.app/apt`), so *Update now* installs a new version after asking for your password, then offers to restart Hebrish. Software Updater, Discover and `sudo apt upgrade` pick it up too. Installing this .deb once is enough: later versions arrive as normal updates.
- **Windows:** the strip links to the new zip on [hebrish.app/download](https://hebrish.app/download#windows).
- Models, settings and downloads are unchanged.
- Ubuntu 26.04 .deb and a portable Windows zip. Not yet tested on Windows hardware. Downloads: [hebrish.app/download](https://hebrish.app/download).
